answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 223 Country: Pakistan Title: In case of taking normal bath, if we wash hands, rinse mouth and pour water in the nose, after that pour water on whole body through shower one time. Is my ablution complete and can I pray with this? Question: In case of taking normal bath, if we wash hands, rinse mouth and pour water in the nose, after that pour water on whole body through shower one time. Is my ablution complete and can I pray with this? Answer ID: 223 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 381=585/H) When you poured the water on whole body then your wuzu and ghusl is complete. You may offer salah until there occurs no other thing that nullifies the wuzu . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
